subject: New tree after scaleClade doesn't fit in image

messages.author: 389d046fc2d602cf
messages.subject: New tree after scaleClade doesn't fit in image
parts:
Hi,

I am using viewClade to have only my in-group in the image, eliminating the outgrips of view. But the terminal are too close together, so I am using scaleClade to separate them a bit. The results looks much better, but it doesn't fit in the image anymore, meaning that the terminals on the top and bottom are out of the page and don't show. How can I "rescale" the entire content to fit the page?

Thanks!

parts:
So here goes an example with a simplified version of my tree (attached file).

tree <- read.nexus("example.tre")
temp <- rotate(ggtree(tree) + geom_tiplab(), node=154)
temp1 <- viewClade(temp, 164)
temp1 %>% scaleClade(154, scale=2)

I want to rescale the whole tree such that there is more space between the terminals, but then the tree doesn't fit in the canvas anymore.

Thank you for the help.

In this case I made a mistake when copying the cope here to the group, but the example is still valid. I am using viewClade to reduce the tree (cut outgroups) at node 164. I consider the rest my entire tree because that's what I want to plot. The mistake was having number 154 in the scale function. I was supposed to be 164. messages.author: cec41188340e8212
messages.subject: Re: New tree after scaleClade doesn't fit in image
parts:
viewClade will set the xlim and ylim and then you using scaleClade to enlarge a subclade, this will of course making the clade exceed the canvas.

If you use scaleClade first and then follow viewClade, it will work smoothly.

In github version, I have updated the source code of scaleClade to work after viewClade.
